intro: Vancouver's election results await certification, alternative AI accelerators are gaining developer tooling, and tomorrow's physical-AI workshop offers a practical robotics session. This is an unattended publishing verification, not a public daily edition.

weather.title: Mainly sunny in Vancouver
weather.summary: The Weather Network's October 20 forecast lists a high near 13°C and low near 7°C, with a 30% probability of precipitation. Forecast checked October 20; conditions may change. Source: https://www.theweathernetwork.com/en/city/ca/british-columbia/vancouver/14-days

stories.title: Unofficial civic results put Pete Fry first
stories.summary: The City of Vancouver reports Pete Fry with 98,494 votes in the mayoral race. The Chief Election Officer expects to declare official results, including plebiscites, by October 21 at 4 p.m.

stories.title: Amazon introduces TorchNeuron for PyTorch on Trainium
stories.summary: Reuters reports Amazon's open-source TorchNeuron aims to reduce PyTorch code changes when moving to its Trainium accelerators, challenging Nvidia CUDA's developer lock-in.

stories.title: AI-linked stocks rebound, but financing concerns remain
stories.summary: Reuters reports a rebound in semiconductor and AI infrastructure shares on Monday after last week's selloff. Financing costs and upcoming earnings remain central risks.

stories.title: The Moon plans Gastown opening on October 23
stories.summary: The Georgia Straight reports a 27-seat dining room, an 11-seat chef's counter and a separate martini bar at 59 Powell Street.

events.title: Vancouver Physical AI Workshop
events.description: Voxel51 and Nebius host a hands-on robotics and computer-vision workshop at SFU Segal Centre, 515 W Hastings. Registration and laptop required.
